name: Marriage Assistance to Normal Persons Marrying Speech and Hearing Impaired Persons
benefit:
1. Marriage assistance amount: ₹25,000/- as

  -  ₹12,500/- National Savings Certificate.
  -  ₹12,500/- cheque/Demand Draft for marriage expenses.

1. Additional benefit if either spouse has a degree/diploma: Increased amount to ₹50,000/-

  -  ₹25,000/- National Savings Certificate.
  -  ₹25,000/- cheque/Demand Draft.

1. Other Benefits:

  - Certificate of appreciation.
  - 8 gram gold coin for
_eligibility_text:
1. A normal person should marry a speech and hearing-impaired person. 1. The age of the couple (both) should be above 18 years.
> **Additional Eligibility:** 1. The normal person and speech and hearing-impaired person individuals holding a degree or diploma are eligible to receive increased assistance.
